scope: Disposable Delaunator plus cocircular index tie hypothesis evaluated on six captured native faces. No application behavior change.
method: Run Delaunator on native captured projected points; for exactly zero floating-point incircle determinant, flip a convex interior edge if the alternate diagonal contains the greatest point index. Compare unordered index triples with the native constructor snapshots.
limitations: The test uses observed native point orders directly; ScanForge does not currently reproduce those orders.
The rule is a hypothesis inferred and evaluated on the same small controls, not independent validation.
Floating arithmetic uses exact zero rather than a robust exact predicate and is not suitable as production behavior.
Constraint recovery, edge identities, cancellation, memory, arbitrary geometry, GUI and MCP are not tested.
